subject: Discrepancy in the Section 26 24 00 panel schedule circuit assignment between Electrical

messages.text: Coordination review turned up a mismatch on the Section 26 24 00 panel schedule circuit assignment between Sheet E-501 and Electrical Detail 2/E502 -- can you confirm which is correct before we release for fabrication? This is routine and can be worked into the normal submittal cycle. No cost impact is anticipated. This is not holding up any current work. Please respond at your earliest convenience. There isn't a real deadline we can set from here; it's contingent on the coordination model update, which doesn't have a scheduled release.
